templates.named_steward: Site operator plus independent safety reviewer
templates.event_use: Modular bays demonstrate models, devices and industrial systems.
templates.everyday_use: Bays become bookable compatibility, safety and maintainability stations.
templates.care_tasks: Power down, erase data, store equipment and publish fault/reuse records.
templates.data_and_safety_boundary: Cleared enterprise test sets and device logs; no unrelated personal data.
templates.retirement_route: Stop on failed safety isolation, unclear data origin or absent human review.

templates.named_steward: Robotics firm plus trained site custodian
templates.event_use: Low-speed robot demonstrations inside a controlled perimeter.
templates.everyday_use: The same bay supports maintenance, operator training and incident review.
templates.care_tasks: Inspect batteries, barriers, emergency stops and spare-part life.
templates.data_and_safety_boundary: Device telemetry and fault codes retained only as needed.
templates.retirement_route: Stop if emergency controls fail, people enter the zone or weather exceeds limits.

templates.named_steward: Enterprise service desk plus qualified specialists
templates.event_use: A fair demonstrates enterprise agents and compliance tools.
templates.everyday_use: A booked clinic helps small teams with data, IP, procurement and scenario access.
templates.care_tasks: Refresh knowledge, remove expired policy and audit answers.
templates.data_and_safety_boundary: Use public policy and user-submitted material; process sensitive files locally.
templates.retirement_route: Stop when sources expire, accountability is unclear or output is treated as approval.

templates.named_steward: Event control plus safety and accessibility leads
templates.event_use: Staff combine crowd, equipment and accessibility alerts.
templates.everyday_use: The room supports safety training, drills and accessible-route review.
templates.care_tasks: Delete raw personal traces and retain only aggregate incidents and remedies.
templates.data_and_safety_boundary: Authorized aggregate footfall, equipment state and staff inspections.
templates.retirement_route: Stop if staff cannot take over, alerts cannot be verified or privacy is breached.

templates.event_use: Bilingual large-print signs, tactile maps and staffed guidance.
templates.everyday_use: Permanent signs and paper routes continue serving residents and visitors.
templates.care_tasks: Disabled users join route audits and log barriers.
templates.data_and_safety_boundary: Public routes, staffed audits and voluntary feedback; no account required.
templates.retirement_route: When digital advice conflicts with closures, staff and physical signs prevail.

templates.named_steward: Community service provider plus qualified health staff
templates.event_use: Explain nearby public health services and emergency routes.
templates.everyday_use: Keep a staffed desk, printed directory and non-diagnostic Q&A.
templates.care_tasks: Regularly verify providers, contacts, hours and referral limits.
templates.data_and_safety_boundary: Use public provider directories; store no symptoms or identity data.
templates.retirement_route: Escalate on diagnostic content, emergencies or stale sources.

templates.named_steward: Cultural institution plus community editorial panel
templates.event_use: Curators lead multilingual routes grounded in public archives.
templates.everyday_use: Residents and students add verifiable stories and corrections.
templates.care_tasks: Review sources and rights, mark disputes and archive versions.
templates.data_and_safety_boundary: Public archives, cleared oral history and contributor-authorized content.
templates.retirement_route: Remove unverifiable, uncleared or unmarked disputed content.

templates.named_steward: Community operator plus student and resident stewards
templates.event_use: The table hosts workshops, developer exchange and open classes.
templates.everyday_use: Daily use includes study, civic meetings, mutual aid and shared meals.
templates.care_tasks: Volunteers and operators check lighting, seating, cleaning and quiet hours.
templates.data_and_safety_boundary: No personal data; only anonymous booking and fault records.
templates.retirement_route: Adjust when events displace daily use, exceed quiet hours or block access.

templates.named_steward: Market operator plus merchant and resident panel
templates.event_use: Events showcase local makers, smart devices and repair skills.
templates.everyday_use: Modules become stalls for local trade, repair, exchange and civic services.
templates.care_tasks: Check power, fire safety, noise, recycling and fair scheduling.
templates.data_and_safety_boundary: Voluntary vendor registration and public schedules; no commercial profiling.
templates.retirement_route: Pause on fire-safety failure, blocked passage or unfair scheduling.

templates.named_steward: Public-space operator plus community care partner
templates.event_use: Provide shade, water, quiet waiting and staff help during heat and crowds.
templates.everyday_use: Remain as all-weather rest, care and neighbourhood meeting points.
templates.care_tasks: Check sensors, water, seating and night lighting.
templates.data_and_safety_boundary: Environmental readings and staff checks; no face or identity collection.
templates.retirement_route: Correct when sensors fail, care is unstaffed or commercial use displaces refuge.

templates.event_use: Supply stands, seating, signs, power and accessibility aids.
templates.everyday_use: After events, lend assets to civic groups, merchants and schools.
templates.care_tasks: Record location, condition, cleaning, repair and retirement.
templates.data_and_safety_boundary: Asset, loan and repair records; no public personal contacts.
templates.retirement_route: Suspend loans when safety checks expire, stewards are absent or loss persists.

templates.event_use: Publish assets, commitments, stewards and conversion dates left by the event.
templates.everyday_use: Show use, repair, complaints, stoppages and next improvements year-round.
templates.care_tasks: At T+365, residents, operators and professionals decide to keep, change or retire.
templates.data_and_safety_boundary: Aggregate use, repair, complaint and spending records with privacy protection.
templates.retirement_route: Retire with reasons when evidence is weak, stewards leave or public value fails.
